description: Ca₂NaSiO₄F crystallizes in the triclinic P1 space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.75 Å. There is one shorter (2.35 Å) and one longer (2.39 Å) Na-F bond length. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to three O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.77 Å. There is one shorter (2.25 Å) and one longer (2.52 Å) Na-F bond length. In the third Na site, Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.94 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.33 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to three O and one F atom. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.23 Å. The Na-F bond length is 2.20 Å. There are eight inequivalent Ca sites. In the first Ca site, Ca is bonded to six O and one F atom to form distorted CaO₆F pentagonal bipyramids that share corners with two SiO₄ tetrahedra and edges with two SiO₃F tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.29-2.62 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.47 Å. In the second Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.23-2.88 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.31 Å. In the third Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.89 Å. In the fourth Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four O and two F atoms. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.21-2.95 Å. There is one shorter (2.26 Å) and one longer (2.45 Å) Ca-F bond length. In the fifth Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.20-2.55 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.34 Å. In the sixth Ca site, Ca is bonded to five O and one F atom to form CaO₅F octahedra that share corners with four SiO₃F tetrahedra. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.52 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.75 Å. In the seventh Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.33 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.23 Å. In the eighth Ca site, Ca is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four O and one F atom. There are a spread of Ca-O bond distances ranging from 2.25-2.52 Å. The Ca-F bond length is 2.53 Å. There are four inequivalent Si sites. In the first Si site, Si is bonded to three O and one F atom to form SiO₃F tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₅F octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₆F pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 63°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.61-1.63 Å. The Si-F bond length is 1.70 Å. In the second Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₅F octahedra,  a cornercorner with one CaO₆F pentagonal bipyramid, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 53°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.63-1.70 Å. In the third Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₅F octahedra,  a cornercorner with one CaO₆F pentagonal bipyramid, and  a cornercorner with one SiO₃F tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 66°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.73 Å. In the fourth Si site, Si is bonded to four O atoms to form SiO₄ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one CaO₅F octahedra,  a cornercorner with one SiO₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one CaO₆F pentagonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 53°. There are a spread of Si-O bond distances ranging from 1.62-1.68 Å. There are sixteen inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three Ca, and one Si atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na and two Si atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three Ca, and one Si atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded to four Ca atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing OCa₄ tetrahedra. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Ca and one Si atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and two Si atoms. In the eighth O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom. In the ninth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three Ca, and one Si atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded to four Ca atoms to form OCa₄ trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one OCa₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one OCa₄ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramid. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na and four Ca atoms. In the thirteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted corner-sharing ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids. In the fourteenth O site, O is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to one Na, three Ca, and one Si atom. In the fifteenth O site, O is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the sixteenth O site, O is bonded to one Na, two Ca, and one Si atom to form distorted ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one OCa₄ tetrahedra,  a cornercorner with one ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramid,  an edgeedge with one FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra, and  an edgeedge with one OCa₄ trigonal pyramid. There are four inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded to two Na and two Ca atoms to form FNa₂Ca₂ tetrahedra that share  a cornercorner with one OCa₄ trigonal pyramid and  an edgeedge with one ONaCa₂Si trigonal pyramid. In the second F site, F is bonded in a rectangular see-saw-like geometry to two Na and two Ca atoms. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 1-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Ca, and one Si atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Ca atoms.
